title: Federal Reserve Board announces approval of application by National Westminster Bank Plc
raw_text:
August 20, 2026
Federal Reserve Board announces approval of application by National Westminster Bank Plc
For release at 4:00 p.m. EDT
The Federal Reserve Board on Thursday announced its approval of the application by National Westminster Bank Plc, of London, England, to establish a representative office in Stamford, Connecticut.
